title: One observer. Several kinds of memory.
sentences: This is our newer spatial memory query architecture.
Think of each component as doing a job: describe the scene, select useful information, retain it, and produce a decision.
We will keep spatial memory, C L S memory, and comparison memory separate throughout.

title: Build a description at every location.
sentences: Each observation is a one hundred by one hundred pixel image.
The appearance pathway extracts color and structure. The temporal pathway compares local image crops with earlier frames to estimate displacement.
Fusion combines these signals, local statistics, and prediction error into sixty four numbers at each of one hundred spatial sites.

title: Spatial memory keeps a map of information.
sentences: Spatial recurrent memory has one hundred locations, each storing sixty four numbers: six thousand four hundred numbers in total.
A spatial G R U uses local neighborhoods and learned gates to decide what to retain or update.
Attention modulates writing, while layer normalization stabilizes the signals controlling those gates.

title: CLS memory is one evolving summary.
sentences: The C L S recurrent memory contains sixty four numbers and changes as selected evidence arrives.
The learned C L S token is a different object: a sixty four number parameter vector, fixed during a trial.
Adding that constant to previous C L S memory helps construct the query. Neither vector is itself the final belief output.

title: Memory asks. Each location offers a key.
sentences: The newer model adds a direct contribution from the entire previous spatial memory to the query.
There is still just one query. Each of the one hundred locations supplies a key and a value, derived from current vision and previous local memory.
Keys determine relevance. Values carry the information that selection will combine.

title: One query creates 100 attention weights.
sentences: Compare the normalized query with every normalized key. Scale the scores, then apply softmax.
The resulting one hundred positive weights sum to one. They form the ten by ten attention map.
The same weights pool values into C L S memory, weight temporal comparisons, and modulate spatial memory writes.

title: Comparison memory tracks motion evidence.
sentences: A separate branch compares an older motion window with a recent motion window at every location.
Attention pools those local comparisons. Comparison memory keeps eighty percent of its old state and adds twenty percent of the selected comparison.
It contains seven hundred thirty five numbers. Its older reference becomes available only after eight preceding frames.

title: The output is a decision. Memory feeds back.
sentences: The readout combines C L S memory with comparison memory, then a task specific head produces answer scores.
Softmax turns those scores into the task's belief probabilities.
On the next frame, updated spatial and C L S memories influence attention again. This feedback lets past observations shape the selection of new evidence.

title: Component jobs are learned through shared losses.
sentences: Training rewards correct terminal answers through cross entropy. V D A trials weight this loss by their assigned value.
An auxiliary pixel prediction error, weighted by zero point zero five, encourages motion estimates that transport the previous image toward the next.
Gradients train the connected learned components together. These are shared objectives, rather than a separate supervised target for each memory.
